title: I really wanted to like it but it did not live up to my expectations
text:
I really wanted to like it but it did not live up to my expectations. The idea of a fully automatic machine really appealed to me. I have a gaggia classic espresso machine and a rocky rancillio grinder that have seen heavy use over the past 4 years. I was interested in this for speeding up the process of making my morning lattes.

I tried several times to use this machine consistently, but I could never get the espresso or the frother to work as well as the manual machines. So I always ended up frustrated and went back to my trusty old manual setup. Specifically, I couldn’t get good creama on my espresso and the frother barely made any microfoam. No matter what I tried, I couldn’t get this to make lattes how I like them.
